Q1.evidence: All JPA/validation imports are jakarta.* (e.g. orders/Order.java, coupon/dto/CreateCouponRequest.java); no javax.* imports

Q2.evidence: OrderApplication is in com.example.order and every component is under com.example.order.* (common, coupon, idempotency, orders, payment, product)

Q3.evidence: build.gradle: only web/validation/data-jpa starters plus flyway-core, flyway-database-postgresql and the postgresql driver, which no starter provides; nothing is added separately when a starter already covers it

Q4.evidence: idempotency/IdempotencyService.execute/replay use web types ResponseEntity, HttpHeaders and MediaType; CouponService.create, ProductService.create and OrderService.create take web request DTOs (CreateCouponRequest, CreateProductRequest, CreateOrderRequest)

Q5.evidence: Every component uses constructor injection with final fields (e.g. OrderService, OrderLifecycleService, OrderQueryRepositoryImpl, PaymentGatewayClient); no @Autowired fields

Q6.evidence: Request/response bodies are records (CreateOrderRequest, OrderResponse, CouponResponse, ProductResponse, etc.) built with from(entity); controllers never expose entities directly

Q7.evidence: Request DTOs carry @NotNull/@Size/@Min/@NotBlank/@AssertTrue; every @RequestBody in OrderController, CouponController and ProductController has @Valid

Q8.evidence: OrderController, CouponController and ProductController only delegate to services and build the Location header; no @Transactional or repository access

Q9.evidence: OrderService, CouponService and ProductService have class-level @Transactional(readOnly = true) with @Transactional on write methods; OrderLifecycleService.findExpiredOrderIds is readOnly = true; controllers and repositories have no @Transactional

Q10.evidence: idempotency/IdempotencyService.execute/replay build and return ResponseEntity (status, Location header, contentType)

Q11.evidence: common/error/GlobalExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) maps every ErrorCode to an HttpStatus in statusOf

Q12.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.problem/handleExceptionInternal return a ProblemDetail body with MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON

Q13.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.handleMethodArgumentNotValid adds a field->message map as the errors property

Q14.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.handleBusiness returns ex.getMessage() as the 503 detail, and PaymentGatewayClient.pay/refund put the raw PG response status in that message (PaymentGatewayUnavailableException). handleUnexpected itself returns only a generic 500 message and logs the stack trace server-side.

Q15.evidence: No @ManyToOne/@OneToOne mappings in any entity (Order, Coupon, Product); Order.lines is only an @ElementCollection

Q16.evidence: OrderService.list reads the lines @ElementCollection for each order through OrderResponse.from inside a readOnly transaction; application.yml default_batch_fetch_size: 100 batches those loads, and open-in-view is false

Q17.evidence: application.yml: datasource URL/username and PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL come from env placeholders and the password is injected from the environment; PaymentGatewayClient takes its URL from PaymentGatewayProperties

Q20.evidence: payment/PaymentGatewayProperties (url, timeout) and orders/OrderProperties (paymentTtl) are bound with @ConfigurationProperties and @ConfigurationPropertiesScan; no @Value
